content: {"phoneNote":"The opening hours block repeats the Monday/Tuesday note twice and the footer repeats hours and directions already shown above, so the bottom third reads as duplicated content.","desktopNote":"The hero photo is tall and heavy while the headline sits mid-screen with a dead band below; the terrace and dining sections are stretched into huge images with text pushed to the far bottom corner, leaving large empty areas.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Desktop: cap the hero and section photos to viewport height and vertically centre the text column beside them to remove the empty bands under 'Terasa' and beside '1990'.","Remove the duplicated 'V ponedeljek in torek…' line in opening hours and drop the repeated hours/directions block from the footer, keeping one contact block.","Phone: make 'Rezervirajte mizo' a filled button as on desktop and reduce the '1990' numeral so it doesn't dominate more than the headline; fix the hyphenations 'Or-možem', 'Re-zervacija', 'la-stne'."],"blockers":["Phone, 'Kdaj smo odprti': the sentence 'V ponedeljek in torek samo za zaključene družbe.
